responsibility: This header declares the LTO symbol-merging interfaces and provides the inline marker/query helpers used to record prevailing declarations during merge. It is the small public interface for code that needs to trigger decl/symbol merging or map a declaration to its chosen prevailing representative, including special handling for public virtual declarations that may lack ordinary symtab entries.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public declarations and inline marker/query helpers for prevailing declarations during LTO merge; unlike gcc/lto/lto-symtab.cc, it is the small interface layer rather than the file that performs node replacement and symbol-resolution merging.
